definitions.explanation: Used for spots or markings on surfaces, animals, skin, etc.

examples.japanese: てんとう{虫|むし}には{赤|あか}い{羽|はね}に{黒|くろ}い{斑点|はんてん}がある。
examples.english: Ladybugs have black spots on their red wings.

examples.japanese: バナナに{茶色|ちゃいろ}い{斑点|はんてん}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Brown spots appeared on the banana.

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}に{斑点|はんてん}ができたので{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the hospital because spots appeared on my skin.

notes:
{斑点|はんてん} refers to spots or speckled markings.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・{動物|どうぶつ}の{斑点|はんてん} - spots on animals
・{果物|くだもの}の{斑点|はんてん} - spots on fruit
・{皮膚|ひふ}の{斑点|はんてん} - spots on skin

COLLOCATIONS:
・{斑点|はんてん}がある - to have spots
・{斑点|はんてん}が{出|で}る - spots appear
・{斑点|はんてん}{模様|もよう} - spotted pattern

RELATED:
・{点|てん} - dot, point
・{水玉|みずたま} - polka dot
・まだら - spotted, mottled
